task: Startup session recovery and nonblocking close

patch.applyCheck: git apply --check --ignore-space-change succeeds against current root; no full-file overwrites
patch.uiSources: MainWindowRecovery.cpp picked up by existing CONFIGURE_DEPENDS glob
patch.abi: MainWindow adds trailing private fields; no existing field reordered; SessionStore adds nonvirtual public canAdoptReload, no fields. Root coherent rebuild required.

changes: Save preflight before canceling any running Engine; a rejected close leaves work and draft intact.
Owned asynchronous QMessageBox offers Keep working (default/escape), Retry saving, Close without saving. No nested event loop in session-recovery dialogs.
Invalid startup with no loaded chats, engines or draft may close without attempting an overwrite.
Persistent recovery strip remains visible on Settings as well as chat; explicit reload requires confirmation when in-memory chats/drafts may be discarded.

Reload loads a separate bounded/validated SessionStore candidate and checks original directory/canonical authority before retiring old owner contexts. Invalid candidate preserves active memory and original disk bytes.

Transition guards prevent Engine hydration, sending, queue commits, conversation lifecycle or sidechat replacement during retirement/cancellation; a terminal accepted close also blocks late saves/new work.
No-chat composer is read-only with an explanation. A programmatic orphan draft is retained if New Agent succeeds; original valid-chat placeholder is restored after reload.
Cached dialog lifetime and identity rechecked after raise; obsolete owner cannot rehydrate itself from a destroyed callback while reload swaps state.

sourceContract.behavior: Window close persists window/tab state; native conversation preservation and explicit recovery remain stricter UX, not a byte-for-byte implementation.
Quit teardown uses a1000ms budget (line1366), then exits. Native aggregate shutdown budget is unchanged in this slice.
Single-instance request lock exists upstream; native single-instance IPC remains missing, explicit reload resolves a stale window after user confirmation.
Second instance focuses existing window upstream; not implemented here.

limits: Single-instance lock/focus IPC remains separate; reload is explicit, not automatic conflict resolution or merge.
No automatic recovery export/copy, overwrite, schema repair, truncation, relaxation of64MiB bound, revision CAS or ownership checks.

If storage changes after the successful preflight while Engines are being canceled, the final save can still fail. The window remains open with canceled partial history and draft; explicit recovery choices are shown. This precise race is tested, not claimed fully transactional.
Reload is refused while Engines/workspace mutations are active; it never silently cancels to reload.
Canonical-directory adoption inherits existing SessionStore authority policy; no broad adversarial filesystem-race proof.
Existing setup-script/editor close decisions and child-process shutdown behavior are unchanged; only session recovery dialogs are newly nonblocking.
Desktop review F4 provider-error-skips-cleanup, F5 settings shortcut routing and F6 sidechat provider refresh are outside this patch; no blanket parity completion.
No user profile, history, credentials, real provider or remote service was accessed.
